notes.title: "Cthulhu Mythos ADV The Isle Of Ubohoth" Complete Edition Update!（2024/12/26）
notes.content:
The sequel to ""Cthulhu Mythos ADV Lunatic Whispers", "Cthulhu Mythos ADV The Isle Of Ubohoth" has been updated to the complete edition!

▼ Cryptic Notes
Hidden across the island, cryptic notes now challenge your wits. Each one is a riddle—put your creativity and problem-solving skills to the test!

▼ Harasho’s Journal
Decode the cryptic notes to unlock entries from Harasho’s journal. This video streamer recounts spine-chilling tales of the horrors he encountered on the island.

▼ Puzzles
New puzzle challenges have been added to your island explorations.

▼ Success Rate Control
Unlock this feature by reaching any ending other than the Bad Ending. In scenes where dice-roll choices appear, a button will now appear in the bottom-left corner of the screen. Adjust the success rate to 0 for guaranteed failure or 100 for guaranteed success. Comes in handy for completing every scenario!

▼ Enhanced Visual Effects
New effects have been added throughout the game to better reflect the emotions and mental state of the characters.

▼ Other Improvements
Design adjustments have been made to the title screen, window frames, and other visual elements for a more polished experience.

notes.title: "Cthulhu Mythos ADV The Isle Of Ubohoth" Additional Feature Update!
notes.content:
The sequel to "Cthulhu Mythos ADV Lunatic Whispers," titled "Cthulhu Mythos ADV The Isle Of Ubohoth," has been updated with new features!
If you haven't played it yet, now is the perfect time to dive into the enhanced experience of "Cthulhu Mythos ADV The Isle Of Ubohoth." Enjoy!

▼ Skip Function
The "Fast Forward" button at the bottom right of the screen has been updated to a "Skip" button.
Clicking it will now instantly skip to the next choice or the start of the next scene.

▼ Ending List
You can now view a list of all endings.
This can be accessed from the "flag icon" on the title screen.
Once you reach an ending, its thumbnail will change, and the ending name will appear.
*If you've already reached an ending, you'll need to do so again for these updates to take effect.
*We're also considering adjustments, as some bad endings are currently very hard to achieve.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2701590/Cthulhu_Mythos_ADV/

notes.title: Update on June 8, 2023
notes.content:
The following features has been added.

▼Scenario Log Function
You can now review the text while gameplay.
The scenario log can be accessed by clicking on the notepad icon located in the bottom right corner of the screen. 
You can access the log screen from the notepad icon in the bottom right corner of the screen.

▼Save/Load Function
You can now save and load your progress during gameplay. 
This feature allows you to conveniently save and resume your game during the day.
You can access the save/load function from the menu icon in the top right corner of the screen.

notes.title: English and Simplified Chinese Update Now Available!
notes.content:
The game now fully supports English and Simplified Chinese.

Click on the gear icon at the Title screen to open the Options.
Switch to desired display language via the Language option.

notes.title: 2023/2/13 update
notes.content:
▼English and Simplified Chinese Localization Update Now Available! 
Click on the gear icon at the Title screen to switch display language.

▼Bug Fixes
・Fixed issue that End 1's unlock conditions not working as intended at the Ending Achievement screen.
・Fixed issue that Sanity values recover unintentionally when companions join the player on Day 2.

notes.title: Gameplay Video & Live Streaming Guidelines
notes.content:
We are updating our distribution guidelines from October 12, 2022 to the following:


1.Gameplay Video and Live Streaming
Individuals and organizations are granted permission to use footage from the Game for commentary, analysis, let's play, or live streaming for the enjoyment of contributors and viewers, both non-commercially and commercially.

Since this game is heavily story driven, when distributing content that is central to the story, such as event scenes, please include a "Spoiler" warning in the video title to clearly indicate that the video contains spoilers, so that viewers who intend to play the game can enjoy the game experience as well.

Also, please include the following link in the description section of your video or live-stream.

Steam: http://bit.ly/3QEZoPn
iOS: https://apple.co/3XwvUFE
Android: http://bit.ly/3GM8jd1
DLSite: https://www.dlsite.com/home/work/=/product_id/RJ424129.html

However, we prohibit the following types of spoiler postings.
Examples: videos summarizing only the various endings, ending compilation, and videos introducing only the rewards after the endings.


2.Doujinshi, Illustrations, and Fan-Made Product Creation
Individuals are granted the right to post their creations on the Internet, for example, on Twitter and Pixiv, as well as the right to distribute derivative works within the scope of their personal interests.
Please, however, do not use official materials without permission.


Guidelines may be updated in the future.
Please review the most recent guidelines before posting.
